handoff.text: Everything else passes, one fail-first gap. PASSED on my build (node v22.23.3, node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-b1r/dist): vitest designTokens 12/12 (node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-b1r/vitest.log); playwright research+research-library+research-pdf+accessibility 28/28 (node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-b1r/playwright.log). Diff review OK: ResearchPanel.tsx touches only repeat-rules wrapper div + Notes markup; label htmlFor/id ok; no new hover/stroke/fill; only transition is the pre-existing transform one; remaining raw px are 2px nudges, -1px, 710px, and project-settings 40/48 (>32); SWEPT now contains research.css and ALL only dropped research.css (spread of SWEPT re-adds it) -- no other file lost. Screenshots (own, light/dark x Plain/Color, node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-b1r/shots, viewed): 12-source-form (Review required details is one full-width line, fields evenly spaced, dark+light); 13-notes (visible Note label above textarea, Add note then divider then Note; fine); 16-repeat-menu (menu open inside panel; fields spaced); 20-settings light-plain and dark-color (h1 19px Project settings, looks right). Caveat: the trigger text sits left of its label (x10 vs x17) as in owner 16.png -- B2. PROBLEM: fail-first. With a doctored CSS build (.repeat-rules gap 0 AND .note-actions margin-bottom 0, in node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-b1r/dist-doctored, log node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-b1r/failfirst-doctored.log) the repeat-rule gap assertion fails (Received 0, expected >=12) as it should, but the Add note -> Note label assertion STILL PASSES. The >=12 px there is supplied by .note-item (padding-top var(--space-3) plus 1px border-top), not by .note-actions, so the assertion cannot catch the margin it claims to test and the .note-actions rule is redundant. author's geometry-before.log failed that spec only on the missing label. EXACT FIX: make the assertion depend on the margin, e.g. measure from the Add note button bottom to the .note-item top edge (page.locator('.note-item').first() bounding top - add.bottom >= 12), re-run on a doctored build with .note-actions margin 0 to show it fails (0), then on the real build to show it passes; or drop the redundant .note-actions rule and the gap claim. No other changes needed; re-submit and I (or another reviewer) can approve quickly.
